$comment: Who may read and write each model of prisma/schema/parties.prisma (rules: src/ownership.ts; roles: src/roles.ts). The office (and the worker and scheduler, in the tenant's system context: the VIES re-check) writes parties through apps/factory-api's modules/parties, always through command(); the API keeps staff to the companies and parties their grants reach. A portal or one-off link session (factory_partner_runtime) only reads (W2b schema wave 23: and adds a delivery address that waits for the office's check), and only its OWN party: the Party row whose id is its party (keyColumns.party = id) and the rows of the other tables whose partyId is its party; it never sees an internal note (the partner wall of src/ownership.ts: every column marked `@internal` or with a cost, margin, wages or pay grain is hidden) nor which office user wrote a row. It does not read the VIES checks: they are the office's tax evidence. The floor reads nothing here: a floor screen that shows a customer shows the name its own record carries. No role deletes: parties, addresses and contacts are archived (status), tax identities are superseded by a newer validFrom. ViesCheck is append-only (`@append-only`; the triggers of the …_parties_guards migration refuse UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE for every login). A measurement profile is never edited in place (a new revision supersedes it): no role updates it. W2b-5 (schema wave 37/44): a rider's team (Party.teamPartyId) is readable like the rest of the party's row; an erased contact keeps its row, and the partner never reads who erased it. After a change run `npm run policies -w @nexus/factory-db -- <folder>`.

Party.about: The office creates, edits and archives parties (parties.manage); W2b-5 (schema wave 42/44): as a supplier its kinds, status and origin (the …_suppliers_depth_w2b_guards triggers). A portal or link session reads its own party's row, without the internal note, why it has its supplier status, who changed that status or who made it.

PartyAddress.about: The office keeps a party's addresses and its default bill-to and ship-to, and approves or refuses (archived) a delivery address a partner user added. A portal or link session reads its own party's addresses (where its goods and invoices go); W2b (schema wave 23): a portal session adds a delivery address of its own party that waits for the office's check (WAITING, asked by one of its active people, never a default: the …_portal_followups_w2b_guards triggers refuse any other partner insert). Never who in the office decided or wrote a row.

PartyContact.about: The office keeps a party's contacts and their roles; W2b-5 (schema wave 37/44): their lawful basis, consent and objection, and their erasure (the personal fields blanked for good, the row kept; the …_sales_intake_w2b_guards triggers). A portal or link session reads its own party's contacts, never which office user erased one.

PartyTaxIdentity.about: The office records a party's tax identity from a date and corrects it. A portal or link session reads its own party's identities (the billing details its invoices carry).

ViesCheck.about: The office (and the scheduled re-check, in the tenant's system context) adds one row per VIES check and reads them as the proof for a zero-rated sale. Nobody changes or removes a row.

MeasurementProfile.about: The office records a rider's measurements and adds a new revision for a change; W2b (wave 21/22): it (or the system) sets and moves when the photos are deleted, the only update the …_portal_sales_w2b_guards triggers let through. A portal or link session reads its own party's profiles (the rider's own data), without the internal note or who recorded it; W2b: a MEASUREMENTS link session adds the revision the rider sent (insert: the link, when, the notice shown and the photos; the guard refuses any other partner insert). W2b-5 (wave 44/44): the office also writes the factory review (status, who, when, the words: the …_mtm_office_w2b_guards let those through too); a portal or link session reads the review's status and words (what more is asked of the rider), never who reviewed or which office person measured.
